# Observability Cost Reduction Plan: USD 18K → USD 9K/month

## Executive Summary
Migrate to self-hosted open-source stack (ELK + Prometheus + Grafana) on AWS ap-south-1, retaining critical SaaS APM for tier-1 services only. Target: **USD 8,500/month** (53% reduction).

---

## Phase Breakdown & Timeline

### Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1–2) | 40 engineer-hours
**Objective:** Deploy core infrastructure, establish data pipeline

**Tasks:**
1. **EKS cluster capacity planning**
   - Current: 600 GB/day logs + metrics
   - Provision dedicated node group: 3× `r6i.2xlarge` (64 GB RAM each)
   - Elasticsearch: 3-node cluster, 20 GB heap each, 180-day rolling retention
   - Prometheus: 2× `t3.xlarge` with 500 GB EBS (metrics retention: 30 days)
   - Grafana: 1× `t3.medium` + RDS PostgreSQL `db.t3.small`

2. **Data ingestion setup**
   - Deploy Fluent Bit DaemonSet (replace vendor agent)
   - Configure Logstash pipeline for parsing/enrichment
   - Set up Prometheus scrape configs for all services

3. **Compliance scaffolding**
   - Enable EBS encryption (KMS, ap-south-1 key)
   - Configure S3 bucket (ap-south-1) for log archive + Glacier transition
   - Document data residency in runbooks

**Deliverable:** Logs flowing to Elasticsearch, metrics to Prometheus (parallel with SaaS for validation)

---

### Phase 2: Migration & Validation (Weeks 3–6) | 60 engineer-hours
**Objective:** Migrate alerting, validate parity, sunset SaaS

**Tasks:**
1. **Alerting migration (Tier-1 services only)**
   - Deploy Alertmanager + Prometheus rules
   - Migrate 12 tier-1 service alerts from SaaS to Prometheus
   - Configure PagerDuty/Slack webhooks
   - Run parallel alerting for 2 weeks (catch gaps)

2. **APM reduction**
   - Identify tier-1 services: keep SaaS APM for these only (~40% of current APM cost)
   - For tier-2/3: use Prometheus + Grafana RED method (Request rate, Error rate, Duration)
   - Deploy Jaeger (optional, lightweight) for distributed tracing on tier-1 only

3. **Dashboard migration**
   - Rebuild critical dashboards in Grafana
   - Establish on-call runbook links
   - Train team on new tooling (4 × 4 hours)

4. **Compliance validation**
   - Audit log retention policies (180-day rolling)
   - Test S3 Glacier transition workflow
   - Document for auditor sign-off

**Deliverable:** All tier-1 alerts firing from self-hosted stack; SaaS APM reduced to tier-1 only

---

### Phase 3: Optimization & Cleanup (Weeks 7–13) | 30 engineer-hours
**Objective:** Cost tuning, decommission SaaS, handle edge cases

**Tasks:**
1. **Storage optimization**
   - Tune Elasticsearch shard allocation (reduce from 5 to 3 shards)
   - Implement index lifecycle management (ILM): hot/warm/cold tiers
   - Compress old indices (50% space savings typical)

2. **Retention automation**
   - Elasticsearch: 15-day hot index, 165-day warm (S3 snapshot), archive to Glacier
   - Prometheus: 30-day local, older metrics to S3 via Thanos (optional, Phase 2 if needed)

3. **SaaS decommission**
   - Reduce SaaS plan to tier-1 APM only (negotiate 60% discount or switch to Datadog APM-only)
   - Migrate remaining SaaS alerts to Prometheus
   - Decommission vendor agent from all pods

4. **Runbook & on-call updates**
   - Document self-hosted stack troubleshooting
   - Update escalation procedures
   - Conduct fire-drill with on-call rotation

**Deliverable:** Full migration complete; SaaS contract reduced or terminated

---

## Cost Arithmetic

### Current State (USD 18,000/month)
| Component | Cost | Notes |
|-----------|------|-------|
| Log ingestion (600 GB/day) | $10,800 | ~$18/GB/month |
| APM (all services) | $4,500 | |
| Infrastructure metrics | $2,700 | |
| **Total** | **$18,000** | |

---

### Target State (USD 8,500/month)

#### AWS Infrastructure (Self-Hosted)
| Component | Instance Type | Count | Monthly Cost | Notes |
|-----------|---------------|-------|--------------|-------|
| **Elasticsearch nodes** | r6i.2xlarge | 3 | $2,160 | On-demand; 180-day retention |
| **Prometheus nodes** | t3.xlarge | 2 | $480 | 30-day metrics retention |
| **Grafana + RDS** | t3.medium + db.t3.small | 1 | $180 | Grafana + PostgreSQL backend |
| **EBS storage** | gp3 (1.5 TB total) | — | $120 | Elasticsearch + Prometheus |
| **S3 storage** | Standard + Glacier | — | $400 | 180-day rolling archive |
| **Data transfer** | Intra-region | — | $0 | ap-south-1 internal |
| **Subtotal (AWS)** | | | **$3,340** | |

#### SaaS (Reduced)
| Component | Cost | Notes |
|-----------|------|-------|
| APM (tier-1 only, 12 services) | $1,800 | 60% reduction from $4,500 |
| **Subtotal (SaaS)** | **$1,800** | |

#### Operational Overhead
| Item | Monthly Cost | Notes |
|------|--------------|-------|
| AWS support (Business plan) | $500 | For self-hosted troubleshooting |
| Backup/DR (S3 cross-region replication) | $200 | Compliance buffer |
| Miscellaneous (domain, monitoring tools) | $100 | |
| **Subtotal (Ops)** | **$800** | |

#### **Total Target: USD 5,940/month**
*Buffer to USD 8,500 allows for:*
- Unexpected AWS pricing adjustments
- Thanos/long-term storage if needed
- Additional SaaS APM if tier-1 scope expands
- Contingency (30%)

---

## Risk Mitigation

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|
| **Elasticsearch cluster instability** | 3-node cluster with quorum; automated snapshots to S3 every 6 hours |
| **Alerting gaps during migration** | Run parallel alerting (SaaS + Prometheus) for 2 weeks; daily alert audit |
| **Compliance audit failure** | Engage auditor in week 2; document data residency, retention, encryption |
| **Team burnout** | Defer non-critical tier-2/3 dashboards to Phase 4; use Grafana templates |
| **Vendor lock-in (SaaS APM)** | Evaluate Jaeger/Zipkin for tier-1 tracing in Q2 (post-migration) |

---

## Success Criteria (End of Q1)

- ✅ All tier-1 alerts firing from self-hosted Prometheus
- ✅ 180-day log retention in ap-south-1 (Elasticsearch + S3 Glacier)
- ✅ Auditor sign-off on CERT-In compliance
- ✅ Observability bill ≤ USD 9,000/month
- ✅ Team trained; runbooks updated
- ✅ Zero alert SLA breaches during migration

---

## Post-Migration (Q2 Roadmap)
1. Evaluate Jaeger for distributed tracing (replace SaaS APM for tier-1)
2. Implement Thanos for long-term metrics retention
3. Automate cost reporting (CloudWatch + custom Lambda)
4. Consider managed Elasticsearch (AWS OpenSearch) if operational burden grows

---

## Resource Allocation (4 engineers, 13 weeks)

| Engineer | Phase 1 | Phase 2 | Phase 3 | Notes |
|----------|--------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Lead (Platform Eng Manager)** | Design, vendor negotiation | Validation, compliance | Decommission, runbooks | 50% allocation |
| **SRE #1** | Infra provisioning, Elasticsearch | APM migration, testing | Optimization, tuning | 100% allocation |
| **SRE #2** | Prometheus setup, scrape configs | Alerting migration, dashboards | Retention automation | 100% allocation |
| **Backend Eng (rotation)** | Fluent Bit integration | Alert validation, runbooks | Fire-drills, documentation | 25% allocation |

**Total: ~130 engineer-hours** (well within 4 × 13 weeks × 40 hours = 2,080 available)

---

## Approval Checklist for CFO

- [ ] Cost reduction: USD 18K → USD 8.5K (53% savings = USD 114K/year)
- [ ] Compliance: CERT-In 180-day retention maintained, auditor engaged
- [ ] Alerting: Zero reduction in tier-1 coverage
- [ ] Timeline: Delivery by end of Q1
- [ ] Team capacity: 4 engineers, 130 hours (6% of quarterly capacity)
- [ ] Contingency: USD 2.5K/month buffer built in
